name: Numulae Gestion de Servicios SOCIMI, S.A.
summary: Numulae Gestión de Servicios SOCIMI, S.A. operates as a real estate company in Spain. The company operates 35 commercial premises, 9 kiosks, and 3 terraces distributed over a total area of 6,978.25 m2 located in the El Arcángel Shopping Center, Córdoba. Numulae Gestión de Servicios SOCIMI, S.A. is based in Madrid, Spain.
